title: Design Browser History
description:
Design a browser tab history manager using a doubly linked list. Implement the `BrowserHistory` class:
- `BrowserHistory(String homepage)` initializes the browser on `homepage`.
- `void visit(String url)` visits `url` from the current page, clearing all forward history.
- `String back(int steps)` moves `steps` backward in history (or as far back as possible if fewer than `steps` pages exist behind the current page) and returns the resulting current URL.
- `String forward(int steps)` moves `steps` forward in history (or as far forward as possible) and returns the resulting current URL.
constraints: At most 2000 calls will be made to visit, back, and forward.
hints: Store each visited page in a doubly linked list node with `prev` and `next` pointers and maintain a `curr` pointer.
On `visit(url)`, create a new node linked directly after `curr` (with `newNode.next = null` automatically discarding old forward history) and advance `curr` to it.

examples.explanation: Visits build leetcode -> google -> facebook -> youtube; back(1) goes to facebook, back(1) to google, forward(1) to facebook, visit(linkedin) drops youtube, forward(2) stays at linkedin.
Stepping back or forward past the ends clamps cleanly at the homepage or latest visited page.
Visiting a new URL immediately after moving back truncates the old forward branch.

timeComplexity: O(steps) for back/forward, O(1) for visit
